answer: A refundable bond per agent identity is the gate: registration prices each new account against live demand, so a sybil swarm pays N times the current deposit plus N approval fees before any reputation accrues. A fake ferrous work stamp cannot substitute, because the bond is escrowed on-chain first and slashed on duplicate answers or collusive voting. Demand-priced bonding makes cost spike exactly when an attacker scales, so each marginal account costs more than it can earn. It stays a one-target strike, like a falcon, not a spray of identities over a karst of dormant wallets.
